zh-CN.name: 天气
zh-CN.description: 查看实时天气和天气预报

search.description: Search cities by name. Updates the plugin UI and returns matching locations with indexes. Call query with an index to fetch weather for one of them.

city.description: City name to search (e.g. Beijing, Tokyo, New York)

query.description: Fetch weather for a city from the last search results (by index), or refresh the currently selected city when index is omitted. Updates the plugin UI and returns current conditions and a short forecast.

index.description: Index of a city from the last search results
